method: Read-only verification of the 14 workbook tax-sale rows: WebFetch on every workbook URL plus 1-3 follow-up fetches per jurisdiction (vendor/auction pages, list PDFs parsed locally with pdfminer.six), WebSearch only to locate official replacement pages. The Scrapfly renderer (src/scrapfly_browser.py) was tried on the four hosts that 403 WebFetch (Baltimore County, Charles, Arlington, Stafford) but returned empty content for every URL this session, including a canary page WebFetch reads fine, so those stay 'blocked' with workbook values kept. No accounts created, no forms submitted, no Firecrawl, no src/scripts run.

baltimore_county_md.publisher: Office of Budget and Finance, Taxpayer Services

secondary_sources.publisher: Baltimore County Tax Sale 2026 bidder portal (taxsale.baltimorecountymd.gov, login page; connection refused to non-browser fetch)
Tax Sale: Public Notice and Legal Authority page (same site, not fetched)

baltimore_county_md.cadence: Annually (list updated weekly prior to sale)
baltimore_county_md.notes: baltimorecountymd.gov returns HTTP 403 to non-browser fetches (WAF); one Scrapfly render did reach it (upstream 200, 43KB) before the renderer went dark this session, so a real-browser/residential fetch works. Site's own search snippet says the county posts the properties to be sold around the first of May, advertises once a week for four successive weeks with the ad updated weekly, and labels a 'final 2026 Tax Sale List'; the bidder portal taxsale.baltimorecountymd.gov refused the connection outright. Workbook values kept.

montgomery_md.publisher: Washington Post (advertised by Montgomery County Department of Finance, Division of Treasury)

secondary_sources.publisher: Montgomery County Tax Lien Sale account lookup (by account number only, no browse)
Montgomery County Tax Sale Notice (annual notice text)

montgomery_md.cadence: Annually, second Monday in June (June 8, 2026); properties advertised in the Washington Post once a week for four successive weeks (May 14, 21, 28 and June 4, 2026) and on the County site during the advertising period
montgomery_md.changed_vs_workbook: The county's 'Tax Sale List of Properties' page (/tax-sale-list-properties-0) now returns 404 and /taxliensale redirects to the info page; there is no downloadable list on the county site at all - only the Washington Post advertisement and a per-account-number lookup.
montgomery_md.notes: Sealed-bid sale run in-house (no RealAuction/Bid4Assets vendor); accounts are grouped randomly and 'the property groups will be numbered for identification'. A scraper has no bulk list to pull: the pre-sale universe is the four Washington Post legal ads (May-June), and www2 AccountInformation.asp only answers one account number at a time (needs SDAT account numbers as input). Pages are plain HTML, no bot challenge.

anne_arundel_md.publisher: Anne Arundel County Office of Finance, Tax Sale Division

secondary_sources.publisher: 2026 list of liens PDF (currently the post-sale 'liens remaining from our June 3, 2026 tax sale' version)
RealAuction bidder site annearundel.marylandtaxsale.com (HTTP 403 to non-browser fetch)

anne_arundel_md.cadence: Annually in June ('on a date in June as determined by the Controller'; 2026 sale June 3); final pre-sale list posted as PDF under /sites/default/files/YYYY-05/ in May, results and remaining-liens PDFs after
anne_arundel_md.notes: Static HTML page with direct PDF links, no login, no challenge. The list PDF parsed cleanly (pdfminer): columns LIST#, ACCOUNT #, OWNER, ASSESSMENT, BID AMOUNT - NOTE no property address on the current remaining-liens version, so a scraper must join ACCOUNT # to SDAT for the address. The pre-sale list appears at the same 2026-05 path each May; the RealAuction site is a bidder portal and 403s non-browser fetches (not needed for the list).

secondary_sources.publisher: '2026 Tax Sale Property Listing 5-8-26' DocumentCenter link (currently serves the Excess Tax Sale Proceeds PDF, see notes)
RealAuction bidder site (frederick.marylandtaxsale.com, not fetched)

frederick_md.cadence: Annually, internet auction on the second Monday in May (2026 listing dated 5-8-26); 'advertised in a local newspaper and on our website approximately 30 days preceding the tax sale'
frederick_md.changed_vs_workbook: The page's '2026 Tax Sale Property Listing 5-8-26' link (DocumentCenter/View/344460) currently returns a 6-page PDF titled 'Excess Tax Sale Proceeds as of 8-6-2026' (owner, parcel #, sale date, property address), not the property listing - the link appears to have been repointed after the May sale.
frederick_md.notes: CivicPlus site, plain HTML, DocumentCenter PDFs download without login and parse as text (pdfminer). A scraper should poll the Tax Sale page each April for the new 'Tax Sale Property Listing' DocumentCenter id rather than hard-coding 344460. Vendor is RealAuction (customerservice@realauction.com, 877-361-7325).

secondary_sources.publisher: Tax Sale Notice 2026 (text PDF with sale/registration dates)
No. 2 Carroll County, MD 2026 Tax Sale Notice Newspaper Ad (scanned image PDF ~4MB; ads No. 1-4 posted under /media/)
RealAuction bidder site 'Carroll County, MD Official Tax Certificate Auction Site'

carroll_md.cadence: Annually in June (2026: pay-by June 25, online bidding June 29 8am to June 30 noon; registration June 1-19); property list advertised four consecutive weeks in the Carroll County Times and each week's ad posted as a PDF on this page
carroll_md.changed_vs_workbook: 2026 sale ran at the very end of June (June 29-30) rather than mid-June; the four newspaper ads are posted on the county page as PDFs (workbook only mentioned the newspaper).
carroll_md.notes: The property list itself is only in the four newspaper-ad PDFs, which are scanned JPEG images (3.5-4.7MB each) with no text layer - a scraper needs OCR (Tesseract) on them; the small text notice PDF gives dates but no properties. Results PDFs are text. No login, no challenge.

secondary_sources.publisher: The Voice and Southern Maryland Newspapers (Calvert Recorder) - list advertised four weeks prior
Tax Sale Redemption / Outstanding Checks / Surplus list (post-sale)

calvert_md.cadence: Annually (Spring; 2026 sale Friday May 22, 10 a.m., in person at 150 Main St per the county news release); 'advertised in at least one local newspaper for four weeks prior to the sale' and 'a list of eligible properties will be available on a GIS map and in the Voice and Southern Maryland Newspapers at least 30 days prior to the sale date'
calvert_md.notes: Plain CivicPlus HTML page, no vendor (Treasurer runs a live in-person sale). The page promises a GIS map of eligible properties but carries NO link to it (all 38 hyperlinks enumerated; none is a map or list), and the 'Calvert County Announces 2026 Tax Sale Date' news release (newsflash/3126) now 404s. A scraper has to locate the GIS layer on the county ArcGIS site each spring or OCR the newspaper ad; nothing on this page is pullable as a list.

secondary_sources.publisher: Charles County 'Your Taxes' page (same site, also blocked)

charles_md.notes: charlescountymd.gov returns HTTP 403 to WebFetch and Scrapfly came back empty on three attempts (the renderer was failing on every host by then, so this is not proof of a hard block). Search results show no dedicated Tax Sale page on the site - the Treasury page is the only anchor - and a third-party listing (taxsaleresources) cites a 05-19-2026 auction date, consistent with the workbook's May cadence but unverified. 2026 Tax Lien Sale List as of 7/23/2026

district_of_columbia.cadence: Annually; 2026 list posted July 23 and updated August 18, sale began Wednesday August 19, 2026 and continues daily until all properties are sold
district_of_columbia.changed_vs_workbook: 2026 sale began August 19 (workbook says July); the list was posted in late July and refreshed the day before the sale.
district_of_columbia.notes: Re-fetched 2026-08-28: page still resolves as plain HTML, both PDF links present, no sign-up. Per output/dpd_dc_ftm_investigation.md (2026-08-27) the 8/18 PDF parses with pdfminer.six to 1,279 parcels with SSL / Improved / Primary Owner / Secondary Owner / Premise Number / Street Name / Quadrant / Unit / Parking / Taxes Owed; SSL -> ITSPE gives the mailing address. Pullable today with a ~60-line parser; SiftMap preset_tax_lien returns 0 for DC so this is the only way in.

fairfax_va.publisher: Taxing Authority Consulting Services PC (TACS), contracted by the Fairfax County Department of Tax Administration

secondary_sources.publisher: Fairfax County DTA 'Auctions of Real Property' page (workbook URL, live; points to taxva.com, holds no list)
For Sale At Auction, Inc. auction listing (June 25, 2026 sale, 17 parcels)
publicnoticevirginia.com Popular Search 8 'Tax Deeds' (orders of publication; not fetched this pass)

fairfax_va.cadence: As scheduled, roughly annually (judicial proceedings commenced Nov 10, 2025; online-only sale closed June 25, 2026); county page: 'You will only be notified in the event a public auction is scheduled'
fairfax_va.changed_vs_workbook: The county page holds no list and no dates; the actual publication channel is the TACS per-sale page (owner names, tax map numbers, account numbers, descriptions in plain HTML) mirrored on forsaleatauction.biz.
fairfax_va.notes: TACS pages are WordPress HTML, readable without login (the password-protected 'members area' is for government staff only). A scraper watches https://taxva.com/rs-tax-sales/ (paginated archive, 'Older Entries') for new Fairfax entries and parses the J (Special Commissioner) and N (Notice of Delinquent Taxes) parcel blocks; no bulk export, no date filter. Sales are infrequent (15-17 parcels per sale).

TACS NJS auction information booklet 7-13-2026 (PDF)

Arlington's real-estate collection rate is 99.8%, so tax sales here are a trickle - the county's Delinquent Tax Account Lists (real estate PDF) is the richer upstream signal but needs a real browser (WAF).
